context: A boss reviews a safety incident
purpose: Teach: 転倒/手当て/灰色/大小/スカイ/ナビ/相手方/袖

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 工場の転倒事故、原因究明、急げ。
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Even pace, no flourish. The weight of command without theatricality. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。応急手当てから二次救急まで、対応済みです。
lines.en: Yes. First aid through secondary care — all handled.
lines.style: Calm, confident reporting. Measured cadence. Each phase delivered with quiet assurance. No apology, no hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 責任、灰色の表現は避けろ。
lines.style: Sharp correction. Pause before the second phrase for weight. Lean in slightly. Not angry, but precise and final.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事案の大小、丁寧に整理します。
lines.en: Understood. All incidents documented clearly by severity.
lines.style: Steady, taking direction. Slight nod in the voice. No rush, no defensiveness. Professional acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 警備カメラ、スカイビュー、相手方確認できる体制を。
lines.en: Security cameras, overhead angle, full visibility of the incident location.
lines.style: Three separate operational points. Pause between each. Businesslike, no elaboration. The tone of someone building a structure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 地図ナビでの位置情報、社内システムに統合中です。
lines.en: Location data from GPS is being integrated into the system now.
lines.style: Progress update delivered steadily. 'Now' gets a slight emphasis — work already in motion. Factual, forward-looking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 制服の袖、目立つ仕様に変更検討。
lines.en: Consider changing uniform sleeves to high-visibility material.
lines.style: Thoughtful closing. Softer than the directives before — this is preventive, not reactive. Measured, almost reflective.
